This is the all-new Nissan Leaf - and it’s undergone a serious glow-up! 

It’s fair to say previous editions of the Nissan Leaf had a very middle-of-the-road feel. They weren’t bad cars, but they offered very little when it came to standing out from the crowd. 

As for the new car, though, it seriously looks the part! The problem is, with new looks comes a new price. So does it offer enough to sway you away from similar cars in its category like the Kia EV3 and Jaecoo 5? Let’s take a closer look…

The front-end of the Leaf borrows from the Nissan Ariya, meaning it has a futuristic yet clean look, including a full-length light bar and a sporty yet stylish low bumper.
